_note: Two words that fulfilment assertions point back at but that no canonical claim covered, because the original tellings are tier 2 and 3 passages that carry no date. Extracted here so the assertions can be attached to something real rather than forced onto a neighbouring claim.

mentions.claim_text: The 911 emergency system is disrupted by overloading the cell network so that real emergency calls cannot get through, alongside attacks on subways and other major infrastructure to cause mass chaos.
mentions.quote: disruption of our 911 system so that people can't call in
mentions.falsify_match: The US 911 emergency system is deliberately overloaded or disabled so that emergency calls cannot get through, as part of or alongside an attack.
mentions.falsify_miss: No deliberate disruption of the 911 system occurs, or outages are traced to ordinary technical failure rather than attack.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the 911 system plagued again, overloaded through SIM cards so that emergency help cannot be called, alongside planned mass-casualty attacks and a van in Chicago.
mentions.quote: I saw the 911 system being plagued that you could not
mentions.falsify_match: A SIM-card or comparable network flood takes down 911 capacity in an American city.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such flood occurs and 911 capacity is never lost to a deliberate act.

mentions.claim_text: In the tribulation vision Bibles collected at the courthouse are thrown on a fire and burned in great quantity, with the national flag replaced by a black, green and white flag bearing gold swords.
mentions.quote: massive amounts of smoke and the Bibles all burning
mentions.falsify_match: Bibles are collected under legal mandate and burned in bulk, with national flags replaced by another standard.
mentions.falsify_miss: No mandated collection or mass burning of Bibles occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a building in his own town as the place where people will be legally required to hand in their Bibles, with the national flag taken down and the Antichrist flag raised.
mentions.quote: where you are mandated to bring your Bible
mentions.falsify_match: A legal mandate to surrender Bibles is imposed at the named building.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such mandate is imposed there.

mentions.claim_text: He names the high school football stadium beside that building as the field where the Bibles will be burned in a massive fire, describing the bowl of the stadium and a tower of Bibles.
mentions.quote: in this field right here they're going to burn the Bibles
mentions.falsify_match: Bibles are burned in bulk at the named high school football stadium.
mentions.falsify_miss: No burning of Bibles takes place at that stadium.
